brand_group: United Cigars (parent distribution company, owned by David Garofalo / Two Guys Cigars, NH)
note: Paths are relative to 'Cigar Images/United Cigars/' in the connected folder on the user's Mac. IMPORTANT STRUCTURE NOTE: unlike previous batches, the Mac's 'United Cigars' folder is NOT one brand's line photos - it's an umbrella distributor folder containing 14 distinct sub-brands, each with its own subfolder. Two of those sub-brands (Atabey, Byron) already exist as their OWN standalone brands on the site and got '_*-additional-vitolas.json' supplement files instead of new brand/line files. Three (Abuelo, Alfonso x2, United) are new LINES that nest under the existing 'United Cigars' brand entry on the site (which currently only lists 'Independence'). The remaining sub-brands (Bandolero, Firecracker, Garofalo, Gold Star, Hightower, La Gianna, Montosa, Red Anchor, Terra Nova, YaYa) do not exist on the site at all and were written as full new brand+line files, since the nested schema's 'brand' object can't be omitted for a brand the site doesn't have yet. This schema has no photo field, so this manifest maps each researched file to its available product photos folder for a separate image-upload step - it does NOT map individual photos to individual vitolas (folders are flat, unsorted mixes of vitola shots).

gold-star.folder: Cigar Images/United Cigars/United Cigars - Gold Star

la-gianna.folder: Cigar Images/United Cigars/United Cigars - La Gianna

excluded.hightower: Written and included, but flagged in hightower.json as an UNCERTAIN United Cigars attribution - every independent source ties this brand to 'Jose Dominguez' rather than United Cigars/David Garofalo. Recommend double-checking before merging into the United Cigars family in your database.
